verdict.rationale: Kit is documented only as a hosted creator platform: its API, a remote MCP server, webhooks and an App Store. Nothing in the pack shows a self-hostable or on-premises deployment of the core product. Self-hosting is a fair question for an email-marketing product, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
